item.title: Cold night ahead; Good Shepherd Center prepares to shelter 100
item.description: WILMINGTON, NC (WWAY-TV) – As the Cape Fear Region braces for colder temperatures Monday night, The Good Shepherd Center is expecting a spike in those seeking shelter. The shelter said they will be housing around 100 individuals on Monday. The center is also in need of several donated items including ibuprofen, medium duffle bags, reading glasses, AA batteries and Fixodent....

item.title: Pope Leo XIV gets into Christmas spirit with prayer for peace at Spanish Steps
item.description: Pope Leo XIV got into the Christmas spirit Monday by taking part in a very Roman papal tradition: praying for peace at a statue of the Madonna near the Spanish Steps on the Dec. 8 feast day that kicks off the Christmas season.

item.title: Economist says NASCAR owes $364.7M to teams in antitrust case
item.description: An economist testified in Michael Jordan's federal antitrust trial against NASCAR that the racing series owes a combined $364.7 million in damages to the two teams suing it over a revenue-sharing dispute.
